title: 新品机会很多，怎样决定先做哪个市场？
topic: 增长战略：消费者洞察、创新目标与收入机会

source.title: Growth Strategy :: The Coca-Cola Company (KO)
source.context: 增长战略：消费者洞察、创新目标与收入机会
paragraphs: Great marketing begins with human insights – understanding what the consumer wants, making a superior-tasting product, and telling a brand’s story in a relatable way by leveraging consumer passion points. We then use these insights to craft a powerful portfolio across beverage categories on a global scale that is tailored to local consumer needs.

Our innovation framework complements our work to build great brands and focuses on prioritizing bigger and bolder bets. Each of our innovations has a clear objective and goes beyond just new flavors and brands to include products, packages and equipment. In 2025, innovation contributed strongly to revenue growth, and we continued to have strong velocities on our innovation. Introducing bold innovations aimed at increasing shelf space and attracting consumers also remains a focus. Examples in 2025 included (in designated markets around the world) Coca-Cola with U.S. cane sugar, Sprite + Tea, Bacardi Mixed with Coca-Cola, Cappy Bubble, and BODYARMOR Flash I.V.

RGM is a key commercial capability that focuses on identifying revenue pools (where to play) and revenue growth strategies (how to win). Our company continues to exemplify leadership in RGM by utilizing our full suite of RGM capabilities to better tailor our brand-price-package architecture to consumers’ and customers’ needs. In 2025, we led the beverage industry in customer value creation for the eighth consecutive year.
translations: 优秀的营销始于对人的洞察——理解消费者想要什么，提供口味出色的产品，并用贴近消费者的方式讲好品牌故事。随后，我们会根据这些洞察，打造覆盖多个饮料品类的产品组合，同时兼顾全球规模和本地消费者需求。

我们的创新框架与品牌建设相辅相成，重点是优先考虑更大、更大胆的机会。每项创新都要有明确目标；创新不只是推出新口味或新品牌，也包括产品包装和设备。2025 年，创新为营收增长作出了重要贡献，创新产品的销售势头也保持强劲。我们仍会通过大胆创新争取更多货架空间、吸引消费者。2025 年推出的产品创新还包括在指定市场销售使用美国蔗糖的可口可乐、Sprite + Tea（雪碧加茶）、Bacardi Mixed with Coca-Cola、Cappy Bubble 和 BODYARMOR Flash I.V.。
收入增长管理是关键商业能力，重点是找到收入机会所在（在哪里竞争），以及制定增长策略（如何取胜）。公司利用完整的收入增长管理能力，更好地调整品牌、价格和包装组合，以满足消费者和客户的需求。2025 年，我们连续第八年在饮料行业的客户价值创造方面领先。
fullTextParagraphs: No matter how you slice it – by consumer, by customer, by beverage category, by geography — we have vast opportunities ahead of us. In developed markets, which comprise approximately 20% of the global population, The Coca-Cola Company has significant headroom to gain share from competitors. In developing and emerging markets, which comprise approximately 80% of the global population, nearly 70% of people do not consume any commercial beverages. In these markets, The Coca-Cola Company has a significant opportunity to develop the beverage industry from the ground up. We believe both the scale of the Coca-Cola system and our growth mindset are key differentiators to satisfy the evolving daily needs of people throughout the world.

Great marketing begins with human insights – understanding what the consumer wants, making a superior-tasting product, and telling a brand’s story in a relatable way by leveraging consumer passion points. We then use these insights to craft a powerful portfolio across beverage categories on a global scale that is tailored to local consumer needs.

We operate with a networked marketing model that integrates product, digital, live and retail experiences and harnesses passion points to reach consumers in personalized ways. To recruit the next generation of drinkers and ensure long-term growth, we have shifted our marketing approach from a TV-centric to a digital-first model that balances local market intimacy, scale and flexibility. Our digital mix has gone from less than 30% in 2019 to more than 65% of our total media spend in 2025, which has transformed our marketing capabilities and is allowing us to create ideas faster, more effectively, and at a lower cost.

Our marketing transformation continues to focus on deeper consumer connections through digital engagement, personal experiences and cultural relevance. For example, in 2025 our partnership with Universal Pictures and Blumhouse brought Fanta’s Halloween campaign to life across approximately 50 markets, featuring immersive retail activations and digital experiences.

Our innovation framework complements our work to build great brands and focuses on prioritizing bigger and bolder bets. Each of our innovations has a clear objective and goes beyond just new flavors and brands to include products, packages and equipment. In 2025, innovation contributed strongly to revenue growth, and we continued to have strong velocities on our innovation. Introducing bold innovations aimed at increasing shelf space and attracting consumers also remains a focus. Examples in 2025 included (in designated markets around the world) Coca-Cola with U.S. cane sugar, Sprite + Tea, Bacardi Mixed with Coca-Cola, Cappy Bubble, and BODYARMOR Flash I.V.

RGM is a key commercial capability that focuses on identifying revenue pools (where to play) and revenue growth strategies (how to win). Our company continues to exemplify leadership in RGM by utilizing our full suite of RGM capabilities to better tailor our brand-price-package architecture to consumers’ and customers’ needs. In 2025, we led the beverage industry in customer value creation for the eighth consecutive year.

Our success as a company depends on a harmonized system in which our bottlers can grow and thrive in the marketplace. Our system is step-changing execution by fully integrating our marketing and commercial plans, investing heavily in digital capabilities and sticking to the fundamentals of commercial excellence to accelerate consumer recruitment, increase consumption and win in the market.

Ensuring product availability is one of our system's greatest strengths, yet we still have tremendous opportunity in this area. While our brands are found in ~33 million outlets across the world, there remains ample headroom to increase outlet coverage, reduce out-of-stock inventory and better tailor our offerings with the right placements.

Basket incidence is another opportunity. To drive basket incidence, our system is focused on better activating integrated marketing campaigns in key channels, increasing point-of-sale displays and winning impulse zones outside the traditional beverage aisle.

Finally, cold-drink equipment is one of the strongest consumption drivers in our system’s toolbox with ~14 million units of cold-drink equipment present in our ~33 million customer outlets. We have significant opportunity to drive additional consumption of our beverages by placing more cold-drink equipment in customer outlets across the world.

notes.meaning: 根据本地消费者需求调整
notes.explain: tailor A to B 表示根据 B 调整 A。
notes.example: We tailored the package size to local shopping habits.

notes.meaning: 优先考虑更大、更大胆的机会
notes.explain: prioritize 表示根据价值和目标安排优先顺序。
notes.example: We’re prioritizing launches with a clear customer benefit.

notes.explain: where to play 用来说明优先进入的市场或渠道。
notes.example: We identified a revenue pool in the commuter market.

scenario.title: 模拟新品立项：先选消费者和首发市场
english: Your team has budget for one beverage launch in two regions.
Customer interviews show different flavor preferences, and shelf space is limited.
Recommend where to start, what the launch should achieve, and how to measure it.
chinese: 团队有预算在两个地区中选择一个推出新品。
消费者访谈显示，两地的口味偏好不同，货架空间也有限。
请建议从哪里开始、这次上市要达成什么目标，以及如何衡量结果。

firstAttempt.prompt: 两个地区的口味偏好不同，货架空间有限。请用英语建议新品先在哪个地区上市，说明上市目标和衡量指标。
firstAttempt.sample: We should start in the region where local preferences best match the product and our retail partner can secure shelf space. The launch objective is to recruit new customers. We’ll track first-time trial, repeat purchase, and sales per store before expanding.
firstAttempt.rationale: 用消费者偏好和渠道条件选择首发市场，再说清上市目标与衡量指标。

taskPhrases.word: Customer research shows different preferences across…
taskPhrases.meaning: 消费者调研显示……之间的偏好不同
taskPhrases.example: Customer research shows different flavor preferences across the two regions.
taskPhrases.translation: 消费者调研显示，两个地区的口味偏好不同。

taskPhrases.collocation: state the business goal of a launch
taskPhrases.example: The launch objective is to recruit new customers.
taskPhrases.translation: 这次上市的目标是吸引新顾客。

taskPhrases.collocation: recommend a market using customer fit and channel access
taskPhrases.example: We should start where the product best matches local preferences and shelf space is available.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们应从产品最符合当地偏好且有货架空间的地区开始。

words.example: A clear consumer insight helped the team choose the right product.
words.translation: 清楚的消费者洞察帮助团队选对产品。
words.note: 由消费者需求、行为或反馈归纳出的判断。

words.example: Each innovation should have a clear objective.
words.translation: 每项创新都应有明确目标。
words.note: 可指新产品、新包装或新的商业做法。

words.meaning: 收入机会；潜在收入来源
words.example: The team identified a revenue pool in smaller retail outlets.
words.translation: 团队在小型零售店中发现了一处收入机会。
words.note: 指值得投入的市场或渠道收入空间。

structure.original: RGM is a key commercial capability that focuses on identifying revenue pools (where to play) and revenue growth strategies (how to win).
analysis: focus on + 动名词，说明重点工作是什么。
where to play 和 how to win 分别回答进入哪里、怎样取胜。
structure.transfer: Our launch plan focuses on identifying the right customer segment and deciding how to win in that channel.

rewrite.bad: Let’s launch in both regions so more people can try it.
rewrite.good: Customer interviews show different flavor preferences across the two regions, and shelf space is limited. We should start where the product best matches local tastes and the retail partner can secure space. The objective is to recruit new customers. We’ll track trial, repeat purchase, and sales per store before expanding.
rewrite.translation: 消费者访谈显示，两地的口味偏好不同，货架空间也有限。我们应从产品最符合当地口味、零售合作伙伴又能提供货架空间的地区开始。目标是吸引新顾客。扩大上市范围前，我们会跟踪试用、复购和单店销量。
rewrite.pattern: Customer research shows [difference]. We should start where [product-market fit] and [channel condition]. The launch objective is to [goal], and we’ll track [measures].

cloze.prompt: Each innovation should have a clear ______.
cloze.why: objective 指一项创新要达成的目标。

cloze.prompt: The team is prioritizing bigger and bolder ______.
cloze.why: 这里的 bet 指值得投入的较大机会或尝试。

cloze.prompt: We identified a revenue ______ in neighborhood stores.
cloze.why: revenue pool 指有潜力的收入来源或市场空间。

dictation.text: Great marketing begins with human insights.
dictation.why: 听出 begins with，理解营销工作的起点是消费者洞察。

dictation.text: Each of our innovations has a clear objective.
dictation.why: 听清 each 与 clear objective，强调每项创新都要有目标。

translationPractice.prompt: 消费者调研显示，两个地区的口味偏好不同。
translationPractice.answer: Customer research shows different flavor preferences across the two regions.
translationPractice.why: 用消费者调研说明不同市场之间的需求差异。

translationPractice.prompt: 这次上市的目标是吸引新顾客。
translationPractice.answer: The launch objective is to recruit new customers.
translationPractice.why: 明确新品上市希望达成的业务目标。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们应从产品最符合当地偏好且有货架空间的地区开始。
translationPractice.answer: We should start where the product best matches local preferences and shelf space is available.
translationPractice.why: 把消费者偏好和渠道条件连到首发市场选择。

choice.prompt: 消费者调研显示，某新品在社交媒体上讨论很多，但试饮转化低，且目标门店货架空间有限。下一步较合理的是？
options: Launch nationally because online discussion is high.
Check which customer need the product solves, choose a smaller channel pilot, and review trial and repeat purchase before expanding.
Add more product flavors before defining the launch objective.
choice.why: 先确认消费者需求和渠道机会，再用小范围数据判断是否扩大。

output.prompt: 模拟包装上市：消费者反馈现有包装不方便携带，团队建议先在交通枢纽附近的便利店试新包装，目标是提高通勤人群的试用率。请用英语说明消费者依据、上市目标，并提出试点八周后要复盘的指标。
output.sample: Customer feedback shows that shoppers want a package they can carry easily. The launch objective is to improve trial among commuters. We see the biggest opportunity in convenience stores near transit hubs. We’ll track trial, repeat purchase, and sales per store for eight weeks before expanding.
check: 用消费者洞察支持建议
说明上市要达成的目标
提出试点渠道与衡量指标

credits.illustration: 新品市场评估：团队比较不同地区的消费者偏好和零售渠道。

blockers: 人工听审音频，确认内容、语速、停顿与截断。
真实账号进度保存与恢复、生产环境逐期核验。
